organic_results.title: Fact Check: No, WhatsApp is not blocking accounts of users who don't forward a message to 10 contacts
organic_results.snippet: A viral message claims WhatsApp will be blocked for all users tomorrow unless they forward it to 10 contacts. The claim is false and baseless; no government order exists.

organic_results.title: Viral 'forward to 10 contacts or WhatsApp will be blocked' message is a hoax
organic_results.snippet: Officials said the government order claimed in the forwarded message does not exist. It is a fake chain message.

organic_results.title: Advisory: beware of chain messages claiming WhatsApp accounts will be blocked
organic_results.snippet: No government order blocks WhatsApp users. Such forwarded messages are misleading and should not be shared.
